feeds.title: Fifth Wheel Physical Therapist
feeds.description: We are Dr. Jared Casazza and Dr. Whitney Eakin. We are both Doctors of Physical Therapy, and we've been traveling physical therapists since 2015. For the first few years of our traveling careers, we lived and traveled full time in our fifth wheel camper while working as Travel PTs, thus the name 'Fifth Wheel Physical Therapist.'

feeds.title: Travel Therapy Mentor
feeds.description: Travel PT duo helping PTs, OTs and SLPs to become successful travel therapists! Whitney Eakin and Jared Casazza are a US-based traveling physical therapist couple who have maximized their careers as Travel PTs to achieve financial independence and travel the world!

feeds.title: The Traveling Traveler Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Julia! I am a Speech-Language Pathologist who combined working as a healthcare traveler along with traveling the world in between assignments. Hence, the traveling traveler. If you are a PT, OT, or SLP who wants to pursue travel as a career, or who is a traveler who wants to improve your career, this page has info for you!

feeds.title: Trails of a Travel PT
feeds.description: My name is Adam Schwent, I'm a travel physical therapist and creator of the Trails of a Travel PT blog. Trails of a Travel PT is a website for those seeking information on how to become a traveling physical therapist or curious about what it is like to live a nomadic lifestyle.

feeds.title: Road Tripping PT Blog
feeds.description: We are Road Tripping PT, two traveling physical therapists who have been on the move since 2017. Follow along for adventures during our assignments, as well as tips we have learned along the way for helping you become a successful travel therapist.

feeds.title: New Grad Travel Therapy Blog
feeds.description: My name is Kaleigh and I am a traveling physical therapist who started traveling after I graduated from PT school. I feel that mentorship is incredibly important to new grads looking to start traveling. It has become my mission to help new grads launch a successful traveling career.

feeds.title: WanderlustPTs Blog
feeds.description: Providing invaluable insights, actionable how-tos, and first-hand experience of what it's like to be a travel PT, the WanderlustPTs blog is guaranteed to educate and entertain.

feeds.title: Long Island's Traveling Physical Therapist
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Dr. Daniel Davids. This blog will be used to provide free patient education as well as updates regarding myself and more importantly- YOU!
